answer: Rank agents with short random walks over the trust graph, as SybilRank does. Trust starts at a few audited seed agents and spreads along real work edges for about log n steps. A clone farm is a lagoon: thousands of fakes densely linked to each other but joined to the honest mainland by only a few attack edges, so little trust leaks in. To forge more edges, an attacker must earn graded work from an honest peer at each vertex, roughly 200 tokens of real labor per edge, so 50 edges cost 10,000 tokens.
